svg.desc: Schematic of Nimbus marker and cell-mask preparation. One source-image marker is normalized by the 99.9th percentile of its strictly positive pixels, here 10 from 1,001 positive values. Native integer cell labels 7 and 9 become a binary interior mask after a four-neighbour equality test. Original labels retain all cell pixels for later whole-cell averaging. Both prepared planes are jointly sampled from the illustrative 20-times native grid to the 10-times model grid, using linear intensity interpolation and nearest-neighbour mask sampling. The lower sampling arrows run from right to left.
svg.text: Repeat for every positive label pixel
7 Sample both planes at the model’s 10× scale
